decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship adjacent to its core cloud messaging offer, it likely has strategic value, continuing uncertainty upside, and low enough extension cost to keep the option open.
It builds on existing document workflow capabilities and already shows customer adoption evidence, so the signal is positive enough to continue rather than abandon.

Although it is a narrower add-on in a mature fax-email niche, it is closely related to the installed base and probably inexpensive to maintain while demand in regulated processes remains uncertain but viable.

As a close-in optimization feature for fax delivery, it likely requires limited standalone commitment and supports the core service portfolio, which argues for retaining it unless usage clearly weakens.

Security features fit the firm's positioning in compliant enterprise communications, and with industry growth and ongoing R&D the option value of keeping it remains higher than the likely carrying cost.
